value.rationale: Provides the sharp (voters,candidates)=(3,3) existence boundary for an observable changing-public-poll period-two oscillation in an established synchronous voting dynamics model. This is qualitatively distinct from its motivating four-voter cycle that leaves public counts constant and is robust on a three-parameter open set, addressing natural study of when near-tied truthful polls fail to stabilize. No unsupported real-world predictions or unnecessary invented invariant are claimed.
